title: Refined navigation bar with descriptive countdown timer and equator/meridian improvements
body:
NAVIGATION BAR & COUNTDOWN TIMER
- Added clean descriptive countdown label ('Next Countrydle in:') and compact responsive timer styling across all viewports.
- Refined navigation header with a single elegant 'In Dev' badge for upcoming experimental modes.

EQUATOR & PRIME MERIDIAN ROUTING
- Mapped equator and prime meridian questions to hemisphere relations for trans-hemispheric countries (such as Brazil, Kenya, Indonesia, and Spain), ensuring accurate territorial evaluation.
